# Audo

> Direct technology help for small-business websites, automation, AI, internal tools, and ongoing support.

Audo is Aaron Hancock's independent consulting practice. Aaron works directly with small businesses to fix websites, automate repetitive work, use AI well, build software, and provide ongoing technology support.

Website: https://getaudo.com/
Discovery: https://getaudo.com/#discovery
Human sitemap: https://getaudo.com/sitemap
Privacy: https://getaudo.com/privacy

## Services

- Website and web application management: ongoing care for existing websites, apps, forms, hosting, analytics, integrations, UX cleanup, and steady improvements.
- Website, app, dashboard, and internal tool creation: business websites, mobile apps, customer portals, internal admin tools, quote and estimate tools, dashboards, MVPs, prototypes, and supported launches.
- Automation consulting: help with repeat tasks, follow-up, scheduling, CRM integrations, reminders, reports, documents, spreadsheets, SOPs, and tool handoffs.
- AI coaching, training, and support: AI use cases, AI-powered website support agents, prompt coaching, team training, privacy rules, tool selection, and AI-assisted workflows.
- Product consulting and strategy: customer needs, product priorities, MVP scope, feasibility, build-vs-buy decisions, product due diligence, M&A technology review, and next steps.

## Service Library

The site includes a focused library of 49 service examples covering website and app care, automation, AI support, technology decisions, and small business setup and operations. The homepage presents three animated, auto-rotating examples at a time, and each service page explains the problem, how Audo helps, the expected result, common questions, and includes a short discovery form followed by live Google Calendar scheduling.

Service pages use clean URLs under https://getaudo.com/services/ and are listed in the dynamic sitemap.

## Why Audo

Audo gives small businesses direct access to a senior technology partner. Clients work with Aaron from the first conversation through the finished work, without account managers or repeated handoffs. Aaron has spent 30 years building websites and software, leading product and engineering teams, and solving technology problems for companies large and small. His background includes Cox Automotive, Dealertrack, Dealer.com, M&A and product due diligence, integrations, migrations, launches, and agency work for organizations including John Maxwell Leadership Foundation, Hattori Hanzo, L'Oreal, and others.

## Client Work

- Boston's Pizza Restaurant & Sports Bar: ADA compliance, marketing site and CMS management, database and server management, and ongoing support.
- Carnac AI Trading: full platform build, creation of proprietary technical analysis tools, crypto exchange integrations, and AI market analysis system.

Aaron's AI point of view is practical and context-first. AI can save real time, but only when it understands the business context. Audo helps clients decide where AI fits, where it does not, and how to use it with privacy, review, and common sense.

For clients, that background means senior product, software, UX, automation, and AI judgment without account layers. The same person can diagnose, build, explain, and support the work.
